description: This file defines the 'FiscalYear' document class and related functions for managing fiscal years in an ERP system, including validation, default setting, overlap checking, and auto-creation of fiscal years.

classes.name: FiscalYearIncorrectDate
classes.description: Custom validation error for incorrect fiscal year dates.

classes.name: FiscalYear
classes.description: Represents a fiscal year document with methods for validation, setting defaults, and overlap checking.

methods.name: set_as_default
methods.description: Sets the current fiscal year as the default in global settings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the fiscal year's dates and overlap with existing fiscal years.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Checks that the start and end dates are in correct order and match a one-year period unless it's a short year.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions after updating a fiscal year, such as duplicate checks and cache clearing.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Prevents deletion if the fiscal year is set as default.

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping fiscal year date ranges and associated companies.

search-terms: fiscal year start and end date validation
